_how_to_fill: Copy to <robot_id>.json. motor/sign: which board channel drives each sim wheel and in which direction (T03 bench, wheels lifted). points: [sim_abs, board_abs] pairs where the measured displacement per 0.1 s pulse matches the sim (T03); sim range is 0.31..0.40, board values must be 35..100. servo_min_duration_s: shortest move time the board accepts (T04). Set measured=true only after the measurements are recorded under experiments/.
